items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: A copy button that shows a check mark when copied, a warning with the reason when not, and announces both to screen readers. Copies text, HTML, JSON or images; works on plain HTTP and in embedded apps.
items.author: Suprabhat Kumar <https://github.com/suprabhat02>

items.name: copy-field
items.title: Copy field
items.description: A read-only value with a copy button: an invite link, an ID, or an API key kept hidden until revealed and away from password managers.
items.author: Suprabhat Kumar <https://github.com/suprabhat02>

items.name: copy-page-button
items.title: Copy page as Markdown
items.description: Copies the page as clean Markdown, to paste into a chat, an issue or an editor: heading permalinks, buttons and hidden elements left out, links kept absolute.
items.author: Suprabhat Kumar <https://github.com/suprabhat02>
